records.title: MagNet: A Neural Network for Directed Graphs
records.findings: Complex Hermitian magnetic adjacency/Laplacian encodes directed input edges; Sec3 Eq3-6 uses spectral/polynomial filters and complexReLU; final real/imag unwind and pair concatenation for linkprediction. These inspected formulas are not a damped terminal modulus-squared readout.
